title: Grilled Sausage with Braised Sauerkraut and Couscous
description: A classic German dish featuring grilled sausage, tangy sauerkraut, and fluffy couscous.
instructions: 1. Grill the Bratwurst over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.
2. In a large skillet, heat the butter over medium heat.
3. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the sauerkraut, caraway seeds, black pepper, and salt to the skillet.
5. Cook the sauerkraut mixture for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until heated through.
6. Cook the couscous according to package instructions.
7. To serve, place a cooked Bratwurst on top of a scoop of couscous and spoon the braised sauerkraut over the top.
